member.name: M:Meridian.PortfolioRecords.FundAccounts.AccountReconciliationChecks.BuildCashBalanceCheck(System.Guid,Meridian.Contracts.FundStructure.AccountBalanceSnapshotDto,System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList{Meridian.Contracts.FundStructure.BankStatementLineDto})
member.summary: Compares the internally recorded balance-snapshot cash balance (source A) against the external bank-statement closing balance ingested for the same as-of date and the same currency (source B) — a USD snapshot must never match or break against, say, an EUR closing balance. When either side is missing (including when only foreign-currency closing balances exist), the check reports because no independent comparison was possible. Returns null when neither side has any data.

Compares the custodian statement's declared line count (source A, batch header metadata captured at ingestion) against the count of persisted custodian position records for the as-of date (source B). When no batch metadata exists to declare an expected count, the check reports . Returns null when neither positions nor batch metadata exist for the date.

member.name: M:Meridian.PortfolioRecords.FundAccounts.AccountReconciliationChecks.BuildRunSummary(System.Guid,System.Guid,System.DateOnly,System.String,System.DateTimeOffset,System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList{Meridian.Contracts.FundStructure.AccountReconciliationResultDto})
member.summary: Builds the run summary. A run is only "Matched" when at least one check ran and every check compared two independent values that agreed. Unverified checks demote the run to "Unverified" without counting as breaks; an empty run is likewise "Unverified" because nothing was compared.
